about: Embark on an unforgettable card memory adventure!

Dive into the fascinating world of our brand new card memory video game developed by the creators of "The Jumping Food" Games. We proudly present an exciting gameplay with a homage to our Jumping Games and a pinch of challenge that will keep you hooked for a long time.
Each of our three kitchens holds unique levels full of tricky card pairs. Find the right combinations to unlock the next level and put your memory skills to the test.
For the ultimate challenge, we've created Endless Mode! Test your memory skills as you try to get the highest score.
Grab your cards and let the memory adventure begin! Get ready to master tricky levels and put your skills to the test in Endless Mode. This is card memory like you've never experienced before!
Pick up right where you left off on PlayStation®4 at any time on PlayStation®5 by simply importing the PlayStation®4 version score!
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
